strings:
Written for Noctiluca's corpus, reduced from the general shape of a shop's
     search results (not copied from any site): a sticky header with a
     search field, a department select and a cart count; a filter sidebar of
     check boxes; a grid of product cards, each a picture, a title link, a
     star rating drawn as an inline <svg> named "4.5 out of 5 stars", a
     rating count, and a price split into parts for show (whole, fraction)
     with the whole price in visually hidden text; a sponsored label; a
     horizontal shelf (carousel) that scrolls sideways with previous and
     next buttons; and a cookie banner fixed to the bottom of the screen.
